info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Advertising Management API
info.description: The Advertising Management API enables businesses to effectively manage and optimize their advertising campaigns. This API provides essential tools for creating and modifying advertising content, targeting specific customer segments, and analyzing campaign performance. Typical consumers include marketers and advertising teams seeking to enhance their outreach and improve ad effectiveness. Leverage this API to drive engagement and achieve marketing goals through strategic advertising initiatives.

post.summary: Create a new advertising campaign in marketing.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to initiate the creation of a new advertising campaign within the marketing department. It supports various settings to configure the campaign according to business needs and target audience.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit advertising data for marketing purposes. It should include all the necessary details required for processing the advertising request.

CreateMarketingAdvertisingRequest.title: Advertising Operations Request Body

campaignId.description: The unique identifier of the marketing campaign.

targetSegmentId.description: The unique identifier of the target segment for the advertising campaign.

channelMix.description: A list of channels included in the advertising campaign.

items.description: A channel used in the advertising campaign.

budget.description: The budget allocated for the advertising campaign.

startDate.description: The start date for the advertising campaign in ISO 8601 format.

endDate.description: The end date for the advertising campaign in ISO 8601 format.

requestContext.description: Metadata providing context for the request.

X-Endpoint-Id.description: This header contains a unique identifier for the API endpoint that was called, which helps in tracking and debugging the request.

X-Runtime-App.description: This header indicates the runtime application that processed the request, providing context about the environment in which the API call was handled.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses JSON Web Tokens (JWT) for authentication. Clients must include a valid JWT in the authorization header of their requests.
